The Missing Piece#000.src: After knocking them out,  RIGHT-CLICK to search workers.
The Missing Piece#000.dst: Оглушив рабочих, нажми  ПКМ, чтобы обыскать.

The Missing Piece#001.src: Now, how to get up from here...

The Missing Piece#002.src: This must be the pipe Bush was talking about...
The Missing Piece#002.dst: Это, должно быть, та труба, о которой говорил Bush…

The Missing Piece#003.src: Hm... There's no sender... Are these all from the same person?
The Missing Piece#003.dst: Хм… Отправителя нет… Все письма от одного человека?

The Missing Piece#004.src: Pick up your post in the Post Office at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#006.src: Don't you see I'm busy!? Take a ticket and wait in line as you're supposed to! I don't care if no one else is here, follow protocol!
The Missing Piece#006.dst: Не видишь, я занят!? Бери талон и жди в очереди, как положено! Плевать, что больше никого нет, соблюдай порядок!
The Missing Piece#006.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#007.src: You could get across this gap by arranging the suspended beams into a path.
The Missing Piece#007.dst: Чтобы перебраться через провал, выстрой висячие балки в дорожку.

The Missing Piece#008.src: Oh, yes! The letters. Silly me, I almost forgot.
The Missing Piece#008.dst: Ах да! Письма. Вот я растяпа, чуть не забыл.

The Missing Piece#010.src: Take a ticket from the Ticket Machine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#011.src: You have to take a ticket, just like everyone else!
The Missing Piece#011.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#012.src: Return to the Post Office at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#015.src: I'll be with you in one second! Gosh, so impatient these days...
The Missing Piece#015.dst: Сейчас подойду! Боже, какие все нетерпеливые пошли…
The Missing Piece#015.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#016.src: Tired of waiting already? Well, someone decided to leave this place a mess for when I returned!
The Missing Piece#016.dst: Уже надоело ждать? А кое-кто оставил мне тут бардак к моему возвращению!
The Missing Piece#016.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#017.src: I come back to the office yesterday from a well-deserved, brief, eighteen week, vacation. And this is how I'm thanked?!
The Missing Piece#017.dst: Вчера я вернулся из заслуженного, короткого, восемнадцатинедельного отпуска. И вот благодарность?!
The Missing Piece#017.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#018.src: Do you see the mess my substitute left this place in? And now I have to clean it up, or the Royal Inspector will have my head!
The Missing Piece#018.dst: Видишь, какой бардак оставил мой заместитель? Теперь мне разгребать, иначе Королевский инспектор снимет с меня голову!
The Missing Piece#018.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#019.src: I'll have you know I graduated with honours from the Royal University of Aelumia.
The Missing Piece#019.dst: Да будет тебе известно, я с отличием окончил Королевский университет Aelumia.
The Missing Piece#019.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#020.src: Frankly, it's demeaning they stuck me out here with the... ugh... peasants! Oh, and don't even get me started on the smell!
The Missing Piece#020.dst: Честно, унизительно, что меня сослали сюда к этим… фу… простолюдинам! А про запах я вообще молчу!
The Missing Piece#020.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#021.src: But anyway, that is all besides the point. What did you want again?
The Missing Piece#021.dst: Но это всё к делу не относится. Так чего тебе надо?
The Missing Piece#021.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#022.src: It's you! You're the one I left in charge over my vacation, you scoundrel!
The Missing Piece#022.dst: Это ты! Тебя я оставил за главного на время отпуска, пройдоха!
The Missing Piece#022.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#023.src: I knew it! A university graduate like me couldn't possibly be wrong!
The Missing Piece#023.dst: Я так и знал! Выпускник университета не может ошибаться!
The Missing Piece#023.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#024.src: Don't try to weasel your way out of it! A university graduate like me couldn't possibly be wrong!
The Missing Piece#024.dst: Не пытайся выкрутиться! Выпускник университета вроде меня не может ошибаться!
The Missing Piece#024.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#027.src: It's not just me who's going to be in trouble when the inspection comes, surely you realize that?
The Missing Piece#027.dst: Когда нагрянет проверка, влетит не только мне, ты ведь понимаешь?
The Missing Piece#027.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#029.src: If you fix this mess you made... Then no one ever has to hear a word of what happened.
The Missing Piece#029.dst: Если разгребёшь свой бардак… то никто и слова не услышит о случившемся.
The Missing Piece#029.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#030.src: You don't get in trouble, the Royal Inspector is happy, I'm happy. Everyone is happy!
The Missing Piece#030.dst: Тебе ничего не будет, Королевский инспектор доволен, я доволен. Все довольны!
The Missing Piece#030.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#033.src: Then I'll have you sorting post like your life depends on it, scoundrel!
The Missing Piece#033.dst: Тогда будешь сортировать почту, будто от этого зависит твоя жизнь, негодяй!
The Missing Piece#033.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#037.src: Sorting is so easy even someone like you should be able to do it.
The Missing Piece#037.dst: Сортировка так проста, что даже тебе она по силам.
The Missing Piece#037.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#038.src: All you do is take the packages from the conveyor over there.
The Missing Piece#038.dst: Просто берёшь посылки с конвейера вон там.
The Missing Piece#038.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#039.src: And put them where they're supposed to go over there.
The Missing Piece#039.dst: И кладёшь туда, где им место, вон туда.
The Missing Piece#039.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#040.src: {p} packages to the {p}, Auburn packages to the {p}, and so on.
The Missing Piece#040.dst: Посылки {p} - в {p}, Auburn - в {p}, и так далее.
The Missing Piece#040.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#042.src: Fantastic! Just don't make a mess of it, okay?
The Missing Piece#042.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#045.dst: О, у тебя и правда вышло…
The Missing Piece#045.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#046.src: Well, that was just the warmup! There's more to come, so don't go slacking off now!
The Missing Piece#046.dst: Но это была лишь разминка! Дальше больше, так что не расслабляйся!
The Missing Piece#046.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#047.src: Hmm... You did fine this time, but watch out, because these last packages come fast!
The Missing Piece#047.dst: Хм… В этот раз неплохо, но смотри: последние посылки пойдут быстро!
The Missing Piece#047.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#048.src: Don't think you're somebody just because you can sort some packages!
The Missing Piece#048.dst: Не воображай о себе много, раз умеешь раскладывать посылки!
The Missing Piece#048.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#049.src: What are you doing over there!?
The Missing Piece#049.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#050.src: Agh! Try again, but you better do it right this time!
The Missing Piece#050.dst: Агх! Давай заново, и на этот раз как следует!
The Missing Piece#050.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#051.src: Agh! Try again, but you better do it right this time!
The Missing Piece#051.dst: Агх! Давай заново, и на этот раз как следует!
The Missing Piece#051.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#052.src: Don't bother me while I'm working! I didn't go to university just to slack off with people like you!
The Missing Piece#052.dst: Не мешай мне работать! Я не для того учился в университете, чтобы бездельничать с такими, как ты!
The Missing Piece#052.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#054.src: Ah, perfect! You sorted the packages!
The Missing Piece#054.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#055.src: But wait, what's this then? Why are there so many packages to the {p}?
The Missing Piece#055.dst: Погоди, а это что? Почему так много посылок в {p}?
The Missing Piece#055.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#056.src: Did you mess up the sorting, you fool!?
The Missing Piece#056.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#057.src: What's up with these packages! They're filled with letters?
The Missing Piece#057.dst: Что с этими посылками! Они набиты письмами?
The Missing Piece#057.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#058.src: Hmph... all of them to the woman on the hill... Whatever that means!
The Missing Piece#058.dst: Хмф… все для женщины на холме… Что бы это ни значило!
The Missing Piece#058.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#059.src: Hey you, scoundrel. This is part of your duty too, you know!
The Missing Piece#059.dst: Эй ты, негодяй. Это тоже твоя обязанность, знаешь ли!
The Missing Piece#059.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#060.src: Go deliver these letters! Or... or I'll tell the Royal Inspector about what you did! That's right, don't mess with me!
The Missing Piece#060.dst: Иди разнеси письма! А не то… доложу Королевскому инспектору о твоих проделках! Да, со мной шутки плохи!
The Missing Piece#060.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#061.src: How should I know! That's your job to figure out. See, it says here 'to the woman on the hill', that should be enough shouldn't it?
The Missing Piece#061.dst: Откуда мне знать! Это твоя работа - разобраться. Смотри, написано: «женщине на холме», этого ведь хватит, разве нет?
The Missing Piece#061.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#062.src: Oh, but you are! I have very many friends, in very high places! Met them in university, makes sure to remember that!
The Missing Piece#062.dst: О, ещё как! У меня много друзей на очень высоких постах! Познакомились в университете, так и запомни!
The Missing Piece#062.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#063.src: Great! Now with that settled I can finally go back to my very important work.
The Missing Piece#063.dst: Отлично! Раз это решено, я наконец вернусь к своей очень важной работе.
The Missing Piece#063.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#064.src: Oh, yes. Very important. University graduate, did I mention that?
The Missing Piece#064.dst: О да. Очень важной. Выпускник университета, я не говорил?
The Missing Piece#064.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#065.src: Now now, off you go. And don't come back crying if you can't find this mysterious woman!
The Missing Piece#065.dst: Ну-ну, ступай. И не приходи в слезах, если не найдёшь эту таинственную женщину!
The Missing Piece#065.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#066.src: But if you lose the letter I can always give you another, they seem to be practically infinite anyhow!
The Missing Piece#066.dst: А потеряешь письмо - дам другое, их, похоже, и так бесконечно много!
The Missing Piece#066.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#067.src: Find out about the woman on the hill around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#067.dst: Разузнай о женщине на холме около [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#068.src: Are you trying to slack off? You still have the letter on you, go deliver it!
The Missing Piece#068.dst: Отлыниваешь? Письмо ещё при тебе, иди доставляй!
The Missing Piece#068.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#070.src: Hmm, you lost the letter? Already!?
The Missing Piece#070.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#071.src: Don't think you're getting out of this! I have spares!
The Missing Piece#071.dst: Даже не думай отвертеться! У меня есть запасные!
The Missing Piece#071.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#072.src: Now go on and sort this out for me, won't you? I have enough to worry about as is without you bungling about!
The Missing Piece#072.dst: А теперь ступай и уладь это, хорошо? Мне и так хватает забот без твоей возни!
The Missing Piece#072.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#074.src: Looking for someone, huh? 'round these parts it's usually the tin cans who do that.
The Missing Piece#074.dst: Ищешь кого-то, а? В этих краях этим обычно жестянки занимаются.
The Missing Piece#074.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#075.src: A visit from one of those and you get an all-expenses-paid vacation on the Crown, if you catch my drift.
The Missing Piece#075.dst: Заглянет такая - и тебе отпуск за счёт Короны, если понимаешь, о чём я.
The Missing Piece#075.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#076.src: Safe to say, if it were Lars you were looking for I'd be happy to rat him out, but you haven't told me who it is yet.
The Missing Piece#076.dst: Будь это Lars, я б его с радостью сдал. Но кого ты ищешь, я пока не знаю.
The Missing Piece#076.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#077.src: PLenty of hills 'round these parts, women too. But they're in the factories, slaving away, not on any hills 'sfar as I'm aware.
The Missing Piece#077.dst: Холмов в этих краях полно, и женщин тоже. Но они вкалывают на заводах, а не сидят на холмах, насколько я знаю.
The Missing Piece#077.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#078.src: Sorry bud, don't think I can help you with this one. Try asking Lars, he's usually hogging the fire in the alley here behind me. Hate that guy...
The Missing Piece#078.dst: Прости, дружище, тут я не помощник. Спроси Lars, он обычно занимает костёр в переулке за мной. Терпеть его не могу…
The Missing Piece#078.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#080.src: Already told you everythin', didn't I? Go harass Lars instead, I have nothing more to say.
The Missing Piece#080.dst: Я ж тебе всё рассказал, нет? Иди доставай Lars, мне больше нечего сказать.
The Missing Piece#080.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#082.src: I'm looking for someone called 'the woman on the hill'. I have a letter I need to deliver to her.
The Missing Piece#082.dst: Я ищу ту, кого называют «женщиной на холме». У меня для неё письмо.
The Missing Piece#082.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#083.src: A letter? Don't know nuthin' about no woman on the hill, but maybe Bush over there would know.
The Missing Piece#083.dst: Письмо? Ни о какой женщине на холме не знаю, но, может, Bush вон там знает.
The Missing Piece#083.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#084.src: He usually knows things... He's a knower.
The Missing Piece#084.dst: Он обычно всё знает… Знаток он.
The Missing Piece#084.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#085.src: Don't talk to him for too long though, or he'll start putting strange ideas in your head...
The Missing Piece#085.dst: Только долго с ним не болтай, а то начнёт забивать тебе голову странными мыслями…
The Missing Piece#085.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#087.src: Ask Bush. I told you I don't know nuthin'.
The Missing Piece#087.dst: Спроси Bush. Сказал же, ничё не знаю.
The Missing Piece#087.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#088.src: I'm Bush, nice to meet you. Is there something you wish to know?
The Missing Piece#088.dst: Я Bush, приятно познакомиться. Хочешь что-то узнать?
The Missing Piece#088.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#089.src: Oh, yes, her... This bush knows her all too well!
The Missing Piece#089.dst: О да, она… Этот Bush знает её слишком хорошо!
The Missing Piece#089.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#090.src: Without her this bush would wilt! Yes, a bush requires water to grow. I know, I know!
The Missing Piece#090.dst: Без неё этот Bush завял бы! Да, кусту нужна вода, чтобы расти. Знаю, знаю!
The Missing Piece#090.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#091.src: But first, I must know why you must know! Do you know?
The Missing Piece#091.dst: Но сперва я должен знать, зачем тебе знать! Знаешь?
The Missing Piece#091.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#092.src: A letter! If only this Bush could know its contents... Alas, it would be rude to know...
The Missing Piece#092.dst: Письмо! Если б только Bush знал, что в нём… Увы, знать это было бы невежливо…
The Missing Piece#092.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#093.src: The mail-deliverer, truly a noble profession. I will share with you her location, but in exchange you must tell her: her friend is back in town.
The Missing Piece#093.dst: Разносчик писем - поистине благородное дело. Я скажу, где она, но взамен передай ей: её друг вернулся в город.
The Missing Piece#093.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#094.src: Here, let me write it down for you!
The Missing Piece#094.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#095.src: Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#095.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#096.src: To know why I must know? Not even I know... All I know is that I must know!
The Missing Piece#096.dst: Зачем мне знать? Даже я не знаю… Знаю лишь, что должен знать!
The Missing Piece#096.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#097.src: Again, tell me why you must know.
The Missing Piece#097.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#098.src: Nothing? That such people existed, I did not know! Now I know, now I know!
The Missing Piece#098.dst: Ни зачем? Не знал, что такие бывают! Теперь знаю, теперь знаю!
The Missing Piece#098.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#100.src: Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#100.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#102.src: Post? You must be at the wrong house, dear.
The Missing Piece#102.dst: Почта? Дом, верно, не тот, дорогуша.
The Missing Piece#102.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#103.src: No one is sending me any of that...
The Missing Piece#103.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#104.src: Well, if it says so on the letter...
The Missing Piece#104.dst: Ну, раз так написано в письме…
The Missing Piece#104.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#105.src: Come in and we'll talk about it.
The Missing Piece#105.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#107.src: I don't usually get a lot of visitors up on the hill.
The Missing Piece#107.dst: Ко мне на холм нечасто заходят гости.
The Missing Piece#107.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#112.src: Place the letters on the table at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#115.src: I think I'll need a closer look at this.
The Missing Piece#115.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#116.src: Please, have a seat. I'll make you something to drink.
The Missing Piece#116.dst: Прошу, присаживайся. Я сделаю тебе попить.
The Missing Piece#116.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#118.src: You don't look like you're from around these parts, do you?
The Missing Piece#118.dst: Ты ведь не из этих краёв, верно?
The Missing Piece#118.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#119.src: Hmm? Well, I shouldn't pry into my guest's secrets. Better to let the unexplained rest, ha. Wouldn't you agree?
The Missing Piece#119.dst: Хм? Что ж, не стану лезть в секреты гостя. Необъяснимое лучше не ворошить, ха. Согласись?
The Missing Piece#119.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#120.src: Here in the Roughworks, we don't have any secrets. At least that's what Her Majesty wants to believe, ha.
The Missing Piece#120.dst: У нас в Roughworks секретов нет. По крайней мере, так хочется думать Её Величеству, ха.
The Missing Piece#120.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#121.src: That's why I chose to live here. In the neighborhoods, the walls are thinner than paper. Nothing goes unheard.
The Missing Piece#121.dst: Поэтому я и живу здесь. В жилых кварталах стены тоньше бумаги. Всё слышно.
The Missing Piece#121.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#122.src: Up here on the hill, it's much more peaceful. As long as the Water Authority doesn't come knocking, ha.
The Missing Piece#122.dst: А здесь, на холме, куда спокойнее. Лишь бы Водоканал не постучался, ха.
The Missing Piece#122.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#123.src: Well, if you're already here, why don't we have a little chat? Not a lot of people to talk to up here!
The Missing Piece#123.dst: Ну, раз уж ты здесь, давай поболтаем? Тут наверху поговорить особо не с кем!
The Missing Piece#123.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#124.src: Pick up the Watering Can outside at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#125.src: The watering can is just outside in the garden. There are three plants inside and three plants outside.
The Missing Piece#125.dst: Лейка прямо за дверью, в саду. Три растения в доме и три снаружи.
The Missing Piece#125.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#126.src: Water Elise's plants while she reads the letters.
The Missing Piece#126.dst: Полей растения Elise, пока она читает письма.

The Missing Piece#128.src: Oh, what a mess... trying to make sense of this is making my head hurt.
The Missing Piece#128.dst: Ох, ну и путаница… Голова болит, пока в этом разбираюсь.
The Missing Piece#128.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#129.src: So many letters, over so many years... who would possibly be so insistent on reaching me?
The Missing Piece#129.dst: Столько писем, за столько лет… Кто же так настойчиво хочет до меня достучаться?
The Missing Piece#129.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#130.src: Hm? Oh, you finished watering the plants already? That was quick!
The Missing Piece#130.dst: Хм? О, растения уже политы? Быстро!
The Missing Piece#130.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#131.src: Well, I certainly won't make any progress like this, and it seems we both are in need of a break.
The Missing Piece#131.dst: Что ж, так я ни к чему не приду, и, похоже, нам обоим нужен перерыв.
The Missing Piece#131.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#132.src: Oh, it's such a lovely day today... Why don't we go outside and enjoy the garden for a bit?
The Missing Piece#132.dst: Ох, какой сегодня чудесный день… Может, выйдем ненадолго в сад?
The Missing Piece#132.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#133.src: Follow Elise outside and take a seat at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#135.src: It really is beautiful today, isn't it?
The Missing Piece#135.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#136.src: Ah... freshly watered flowers. Nothing beats that smell.
The Missing Piece#136.dst: Ах… свежеполитые цветы. Лучше этого запаха нет.
The Missing Piece#136.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#137.src: Hm. Do you see that tree over there?
The Missing Piece#137.dst: Хм. Видишь то дерево вон там?
The Missing Piece#137.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#138.src: It's the only one of its kind in the whole of the Roughworks. Isn't it beautiful?
The Missing Piece#138.dst: Такое во всём Roughworks одно-единственное. Красивое, правда?
The Missing Piece#138.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#139.src: It was a gift, but from who... It's another thing I've forgotten.
The Missing Piece#139.dst: Это был подарок, но от кого… Ещё одно, что я забыла.
The Missing Piece#139.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#140.src: It's frustrating, so frustrating... All these precious memories...
The Missing Piece#140.dst: Обидно, так обидно… Все эти дорогие воспоминания…
The Missing Piece#140.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#142.src: It isn't much now, that is for certain.
The Missing Piece#142.dst: Пока оно не ахти, это точно.

The Missing Piece#143.src: Well. It's beautiful already, don't you think?
The Missing Piece#143.dst: Ну. Оно уже красивое, не находишь?
The Missing Piece#143.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#145.src: Ha! Of course it will, it's a tree!
The Missing Piece#145.dst: Ха! Конечно, вырастет, это же дерево!
The Missing Piece#145.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#146.src: Oh, you know I didn't mean it like that.
The Missing Piece#146.dst: Ох, ты же знаешь, я не о том.

The Missing Piece#147.src: For each year that passes... this tree will grow taller, and ever more beautiful.
The Missing Piece#147.dst: С каждым годом… это дерево будет всё выше и всё прекраснее.

The Missing Piece#148.src: It'll have to weather many storms, and on some days it might even have to go without water. And still, it will continue growing.
The Missing Piece#148.dst: Ему придётся пережить много бурь, а порой и остаться без воды. И всё равно оно будет расти.

The Missing Piece#150.src: And then in ten, fifteen, maybe even twenty-five years... we'll finally be able to rest in its shade.
The Missing Piece#150.dst: А через десять, пятнадцать, может, двадцать пять лет… мы наконец отдохнём в его тени.

The Missing Piece#151.src: Twenty-five years!? We'll be old by then!
The Missing Piece#151.dst: Двадцать пять лет!? Мы же состаримся!
The Missing Piece#151.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#152.src: Oh, I know! We could have a picnic underneath its canopy Doesn't that sound nice, {u}?
The Missing Piece#152.dst: О, придумала! Устроим пикник под его кроной. Правда, здорово, {u}?
The Missing Piece#152.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#153.src: ... It does. It does sound nice, Elise. Perhaps we could.
The Missing Piece#153.dst: … Здорово. Правда здорово, Elise. Может, и устроим.

The Missing Piece#154.src: Go on, give it some more water. Or it'll never grow an inch!
The Missing Piece#154.dst: Давай, полей его ещё. А то оно ни на дюйм не вырастет!

The Missing Piece#159.src: I was just thinking... If I were to die some day, I'd like to be buried here, under the tree.
The Missing Piece#159.dst: Я просто подумала… Если я когда-нибудь умру, хочу лежать здесь, под деревом.

The Missing Piece#160.src: Huh? What could possibly make you think about such silly things? We still have a long life left ahead of us, don't we?
The Missing Piece#160.dst: А? С чего ты вообще думаешь о таких глупостях? У нас впереди ещё долгая жизнь, разве нет?
The Missing Piece#160.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#161.src: Of course, you're right. I'm sorry, I'm just not used to this...
The Missing Piece#161.dst: Конечно, ты права. Прости, я просто к этому не привыкла…

The Missing Piece#164.src: Let's just enjoy the sun, for a bit. There's still work tomorrow.
The Missing Piece#164.dst: Давай просто погреемся на солнце. Завтра опять на работу.
The Missing Piece#164.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#167.src: Hm. I shall leave the worrying for another day, I think. Today is a good day... not a day for worrying.
The Missing Piece#167.dst: Хм. Пожалуй, оставлю тревоги на другой день. Сегодня хороший день… не для тревог.
The Missing Piece#167.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#168.src: In fact, today is too nice a day to waste it... by not going anywhere, that is. Wouldn't you agree?
The Missing Piece#168.dst: Да и слишком хорош сегодня день, чтобы тратить его… сидя дома, то есть. Согласись?
The Missing Piece#168.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#170.src: Follow Elise to the roof at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#171.src: Ah... Do you see that factory off that way? I used to work there, back when I was younger...
The Missing Piece#171.dst: Ах… Видишь вон тот завод? Я там работала, когда была моложе…
The Missing Piece#171.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#172.src: We mass-produced bread for the higher regions... Tedious work, and thankless too.
The Missing Piece#172.dst: Мы пекли хлеб тоннами для верхних районов… Нудная работа, да ещё и неблагодарная.
The Missing Piece#172.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#173.src: I'm sure you have noticed, but things around here aren't too easy. Some people even go as far as stealing when times are tough...
The Missing Piece#173.dst: Ты, конечно, уже понимаешь: жизнь тут нелёгкая. В трудные времена кое-кто даже воровать идёт…
The Missing Piece#173.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#174.src: Fortunately... I never had to. They would let us take some home, every once in a while.
The Missing Piece#174.dst: К счастью… мне не приходилось. Иногда нам разрешали взять немного домой.
The Missing Piece#174.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#175.src: Those were good days. On those occasions, we'd go and have ourselves a picnic, me and- hm. Just me, I suppose.
The Missing Piece#175.dst: Хорошие были дни. В такие дни мы ходили на пикник, я и- хм. Только я, наверное.
The Missing Piece#175.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#176.src: A shame it's so hard to come by... the thefts became a real problem, you know. The Crown ended up building a vault down under the factory to keep it all secure!
The Missing Piece#176.dst: Жаль, его так трудно достать… кражи стали настоящей бедой. Корона даже построила под заводом хранилище, чтобы всё уберечь!
The Missing Piece#176.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#177.src: How long, since I last had some? Years, surely... not like any of that bread ever makes it to us poor folk, ha!
The Missing Piece#177.dst: Когда я его ела в последний раз? Годы назад, не иначе… до нас, бедняков, этот хлеб всё равно не доходит, ха!
The Missing Piece#177.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#178.src: But it'd be nice to have some again, I suppose... reminisce on old times.
The Missing Piece#178.dst: Но было бы славно снова его отведать… вспомнить былое.
The Missing Piece#178.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#179.src: Well, if you're running errands for me already... mind seeing if you can get your hands on a loaf or two?
The Missing Piece#179.dst: Раз уж ты всё равно у меня на побегушках… может, раздобудешь буханку-другую?
The Missing Piece#179.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#180.src: It's expensive, but for the right price... I'm sure you could get ahold of some. You don't seem the sort to struggle with that kind of thing, do you, letter carrier?
The Missing Piece#180.dst: Он дорогой, но за хорошую цену… уверена, достать можно. Ты не из тех, кому такое в тягость, правда, почтальон?
The Missing Piece#180.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#181.src: Ha! Well, do your best, either way. Once you come back, I have a plan for what we can do today. How's that sound?
The Missing Piece#181.dst: Ха! В общем, постарайся. Когда вернёшься, у меня будет план на сегодня. Как тебе?
The Missing Piece#181.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#182.src: Try to enter the Bread Factory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#183.src: Oh, no... You know! You know! Speak to that constable first, and perhaps, I'll tell you more.
The Missing Piece#183.dst: О нет… Ты знаешь! Знаешь! Сперва поговори с тем констеблем, и, быть может, я расскажу больше.
The Missing Piece#183.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#184.src: If you've come to beg, you might as well leave.
The Missing Piece#184.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#185.src: Huh? Alright, bud. We all do.
The Missing Piece#185.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#187.src: Do I look like a vending machine to you? Go find somewhere else. We just make bread here, we don't sell it.
The Missing Piece#187.dst: Я похож на торговый автомат? Ищи в другом месте. Мы тут хлеб делаем, а не продаём.
The Missing Piece#187.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#188.src: Get out of here pal, you shouldn't be loitering around under a Constable's watch.
The Missing Piece#188.dst: Проваливай, приятель, нечего слоняться под носом у констебля.
The Missing Piece#188.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#189.src: But, but, but! No buts. Don't make me have to do something! The paperwork is always such a hassle...
The Missing Piece#189.dst: Но, но, но! Никаких «но». Не заставляй меня принимать меры! Потом бумажной волокиты не оберёшься…
The Missing Piece#189.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#191.src: Obviously not... We have enough problems as it is, what with that stolen barrel last week... And the production quotas...
The Missing Piece#191.dst: Конечно, нет… У нас и так проблем хватает: на прошлой неделе бочку украли… Да ещё план по выпуску…
The Missing Piece#191.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#192.src: Don't you have something better to do anyway?
The Missing Piece#192.speaker: Constable

The Missing Piece#194.src: Over here, friend of a friend!

The Missing Piece#196.src: Did you know? Did you know? There is more than one way to enter any building.
The Missing Piece#196.dst: А знаешь? Знаешь? В любое здание можно попасть не одним путём.
The Missing Piece#196.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#197.src: I'll tell you! But, stealing is unethical, you must know!
The Missing Piece#197.dst: Я расскажу! Но воровать неэтично, это надо знать!
The Missing Piece#197.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#198.src: As long as she doesn't know! She won't know! Do you understand?
The Missing Piece#198.dst: Лишь бы она не знала! Она не узнает! Понимаешь?
The Missing Piece#198.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#199.src: It's just around the corner, you see. A pipe! Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#199.dst: Прямо за углом, видишь ли. Труба! Теперь ты знаешь! Теперь знаешь!
The Missing Piece#199.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#200.src: Enter the Bread Factory through the pipe at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#201.src: It's just around the corner, you see. A pipe! Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#201.dst: Прямо за углом, видишь ли. Труба! Теперь ты знаешь! Теперь знаешь!
The Missing Piece#201.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#203.src: Find a way to enter the Bread Vault through the elevator at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#203.dst: Найди способ попасть в Хлебное хранилище через лифт: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#206.src: Uhh? That's not an answer! Now, tell me who you are or I'll have a look for myself! And I never forget faces, keep that in mind!
The Missing Piece#206.dst: Э? Это не ответ! Говори, кто ты, или я сам погляжу! И я никогда не забываю лиц, учти!
The Missing Piece#206.speaker: Supervisor

The Missing Piece#207.src: What's a worker doing in my office!? Now, tell me who you are or I'll have a look for myself! And I never forget faces, keep that in mind!
The Missing Piece#207.dst: Что рабочий делает в моём кабинете!? Говори, кто ты, или сам погляжу! И лиц я не забываю, учти!
The Missing Piece#207.speaker: Supervisor

The Missing Piece#209.src: Well, thank you for bringing this to my attention! I will investigate the matter immediately!
The Missing Piece#209.dst: Что ж, спасибо за сигнал! Немедленно разберусь!
The Missing Piece#209.speaker: Supervisor

The Missing Piece#211.src: Make your way through the Bread Vault to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#213.src: Hit the bottles at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with a Bottle.

The Missing Piece#214.src: Continue through the Bread Vault to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#215.src: Use the beams to make it across to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#217.src: ...and in accordance with our protocols, we will require a detailed record of this former employee. Years of employment, known associates, work performance... all of it.
The Missing Piece#217.dst: …и согласно нашему регламенту нам нужно подробное досье на эту бывшую работницу. Стаж, известные связи, успехи в работе… всё.
The Missing Piece#217.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#218.src: Naturally, I will comply to the best of my ability, blessed be Her Grace. But to think that the mere theft of one crate would reach this high a level...
The Missing Piece#218.dst: Разумеется, я всячески посодействую, да благословенна Её Милость. Но подумать только, кража одного ящика дошла до таких высот…
The Missing Piece#218.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#219.src: The crate is not relevant. It is the employee who is of interest. Further measures may be necessary, but the records will do well to begin with.
The Missing Piece#219.dst: Ящик не важен. Нас интересует работница. Могут понадобиться дальнейшие меры, но для начала хватит досье.
The Missing Piece#219.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#220.src: ...only the employee? Pardon my questions, but I do not understand why she is of interest to you.
The Missing Piece#220.dst: …только работница? Простите за вопрос, но я не понимаю, чем она вам интересна.
The Missing Piece#220.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#221.src: That is for us to know, and for you to comply. But it pertains to a potential security breach which we are investigating.
The Missing Piece#221.dst: Это нам знать, а вам - исполнять. Но дело касается возможной бреши в безопасности, которую мы расследуем.
The Missing Piece#221.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#222.src: At my factory? What are you implying!?
The Missing Piece#222.dst: На моём заводе? На что вы намекаете!?
The Missing Piece#222.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#223.src: I imply nothing. Must you be reminded of your position? It is by Her Majesty's will that I am here today. Do you truly wish to stand against it?
The Missing Piece#223.dst: Я ни на что не намекаю. Напомнить вам ваше место? Я здесь по воле Её Величества. Вы правда хотите ей перечить?
The Missing Piece#223.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#224.src: I... I humbly apologize... I didn't mean-
The Missing Piece#224.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#226.src: Y-yes, of course. But, still, I had thought that matter was settled years ago! What connection could it possibly have to-
The Missing Piece#226.dst: Д-да, конечно. Но я-то думал, то дело закрыли много лет назад! Какая может быть связь с-
The Missing Piece#226.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#227.src: Enough aimless rambling. My time is limited. Pull up those records on this Elise, immediately.
The Missing Piece#227.dst: Хватит бессвязной болтовни. Моё время ограничено. Немедленно поднимите досье на эту Elise.
The Missing Piece#227.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#228.src: U-understood, ma'am... I'll get them right away.
The Missing Piece#228.speaker: Vault Chief

The Missing Piece#229.src: Use the beams to make it across to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#230.src: Acquire the bread from the barrel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#231.src: Continue through the Bread Vault to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#232.src: Find the way out of the Bread Vault at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#233.src: Well, well, well... it would seem the rats aren't the only plague to infest this place.
The Missing Piece#233.dst: Так-так-так… похоже, крысы тут не единственная зараза.
The Missing Piece#233.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#234.src: And here I had thought this particular lead was dead end! Only years-old records which tell us nothing we did not already know... always a risk, but worth checking regardless.
The Missing Piece#234.dst: А я-то думала, эта ниточка ведёт в тупик! Лишь старые записи, где ничего нового… риск всегда есть, но проверить стоило.
The Missing Piece#234.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#235.src: But here you are. One of the province's most wanted criminals. What a strange coincidence, finding you here.
The Missing Piece#235.dst: Но вот ты здесь - в розыске по всей провинции. Какое странное совпадение, встретить тебя тут.
The Missing Piece#235.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#236.src: I must wonder... for what reason are you here?
The Missing Piece#236.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#237.src: I know better than to expect an answer. But it does not matter, in the end. We will get it out of you eventually.
The Missing Piece#237.dst: Ответа я не жду. Да это и неважно. Рано или поздно мы его из тебя вытянем.
The Missing Piece#237.speaker: Inquisitor

The Missing Piece#241.src: Return to the Roughworks through the pipe at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#243.src: Confront the inspection or talk to Elise at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Missing Piece#243.dst: Встреть проверку или поговори с Elise: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#244.src: Oh, it's the Water Authority! I don't know why they're here... but it can't be for any good reason.
The Missing Piece#244.dst: Ох, это Водоканал! Не знаю, зачем они пришли… но явно не с добром.
The Missing Piece#244.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#245.src: Open up already! We know you're in there!
The Missing Piece#245.dst: Открывай уже! Мы знаем, что ты там!
The Missing Piece#245.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#246.src: Really, you should hide. It's okay, I've dealt with their type before. I'll send them away.
The Missing Piece#246.dst: Правда, тебе лучше спрятаться. Всё хорошо, я и раньше с такими имела дело. Я их спроважу.
The Missing Piece#246.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#248.src: Good. Quick, find somewhere to hide!
The Missing Piece#248.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#249.src: Wait one second! I'll hide behind the plant!
The Missing Piece#249.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#253.src: A friend, you say? Then you should be able to tell me why she's not answering the door!
The Missing Piece#253.dst: Друг, говоришь? Тогда объясни, почему она не открывает дверь!
The Missing Piece#253.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#255.src: Someone like me!? What's that supposed to mean?
The Missing Piece#255.dst: Такие, как я!? Это ещё что значит?
The Missing Piece#255.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#256.src: Oh, you'll pay for this insult! We have authority to enforce our orders with force, you know! We can do anything we want!
The Missing Piece#256.dst: О, ты заплатишь за это оскорбление! Мы вправе исполнять приказы силой, знаешь ли! Мы можем делать что хотим!
The Missing Piece#256.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#257.src: Not at home, you say? How convenient. Just as the inspection comes around they're not at home to greet us!
The Missing Piece#257.dst: Нет дома, говоришь? Как удобно. Именно к приходу проверки хозяев нет дома, чтобы нас встретить!
The Missing Piece#257.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#258.src: It's almost like someone tipped them off, don't you think?
The Missing Piece#258.dst: Будто кто-то их предупредил, не находишь?
The Missing Piece#258.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#259.src: Say friend, did you tip off the subject that we were coming?
The Missing Piece#259.dst: Скажи-ка, друг, не от тебя ли хозяйка узнала о нашем приходе?
The Missing Piece#259.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#260.src: Very well, then. But we will still need to get in to conduct the search.
The Missing Piece#260.dst: Что ж, ладно. Но нам всё равно нужно войти для обыска.
The Missing Piece#260.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#261.src: If you won't be of any use, then you better get out of our way!
The Missing Piece#261.dst: Раз от тебя никакого толку, уйди с дороги!
The Missing Piece#261.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#262.src: At the bread factory? That's none of our concern, we're the Water Authority, not the Bread Authority!
The Missing Piece#262.dst: На хлебозаводе? Нас это не касается, мы Водоканал, а не Хлебоканал!
The Missing Piece#262.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#263.src: A massive water spillage, you say!?
The Missing Piece#263.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#264.src: And you're not making this up? We don't take easily to liars, you should know.
The Missing Piece#264.dst: И ты это не выдумываешь? Лжецов мы не жалуем, так и знай.
The Missing Piece#264.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#265.src: Inspector, there seems to be some commotion coming from the Bread Factory.
The Missing Piece#265.dst: Инспектор, на хлебозаводе, кажется, какой-то переполох.
The Missing Piece#265.speaker: Sentinel

The Missing Piece#266.src: Hmm... Well, in that case, we'll have to check it out. Thank you for the information, citizen.
The Missing Piece#266.dst: Хм… Что ж, тогда придётся проверить. Благодарим за сведения.
The Missing Piece#266.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#267.src: Passing by! As if! Did you really think I would believe that story?
The Missing Piece#267.dst: Мимо, значит, шли? Как же! Думаешь, я поверю в эту сказку?
The Missing Piece#267.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#268.src: Oh, you'll pay for this insult! We have authority to enforce our orders with force, you know! We can do anything we want!
The Missing Piece#268.dst: О, ты заплатишь за это оскорбление! Мы вправе исполнять приказы силой, знаешь ли! Мы можем делать что хотим!
The Missing Piece#268.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#269.src: We are here to execute a search. Your water usage levels have exceeded your authorized allotment.
The Missing Piece#269.dst: Мы здесь для обыска. Твой расход воды превысил разрешённую норму.
The Missing Piece#269.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#272.src: Very well. We will now conduct an inspection of your property. Step out of the way, subject.
The Missing Piece#272.dst: Хорошо. Сейчас проведём осмотр жилища. Отойди, подданный.
The Missing Piece#272.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#273.src: What's this? No wonder you're exceeding your water limit when you've been keeping illicit plants!
The Missing Piece#273.dst: Что это? Неудивительно, что расход воды превышен, когда тут незаконные растения!
The Missing Piece#273.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#274.src: Wait a second... There's someone hiding behind there! You said you were alone!
The Missing Piece#274.dst: Погоди-ка… Там кто-то прячется! А сказано было, что никого нет!
The Missing Piece#274.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#275.src: Oh, you'll pay for this insult! We have authority to enforce our orders with force, you know! We can do anything we want!
The Missing Piece#275.dst: О, ты заплатишь за это оскорбление! Мы вправе исполнять приказы силой, знаешь ли! Мы можем делать что хотим!
The Missing Piece#275.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#279.src: Noooooooo, Alphonse! How... How could you do this!?
The Missing Piece#279.dst: Нееет, Alphonse! Как… Как у тебя рука поднялась!?
The Missing Piece#279.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#280.src: You'll pay for this, you rat! In the name of Her Majesty!
The Missing Piece#280.dst: Ты за это заплатишь, крыса! Именем Её Величества!
The Missing Piece#280.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#281.src: Are you alright!? I heard a commotion, and
The Missing Piece#281.dst: Всё в порядке!? Я услышала шум, и
The Missing Piece#281.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#283.src: You may as well come inside, dearie.
The Missing Piece#283.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#285.src: But how strange... The authorities have never bothered me before... Oh, let's just get inside for now.
The Missing Piece#285.dst: Но как странно… Власти никогда меня не беспокоили… Ох, давай пока просто зайдём.
The Missing Piece#285.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#286.src: Find somewhere to hide in Elise's house!
The Missing Piece#286.dst: Найди, где спрятаться в доме Elise!

The Missing Piece#289.src: There you go. Now, what business could Her Majesty's authorities possibly have with little old me?
The Missing Piece#289.dst: Вот. Итак, какое дело властям Её Величества до меня, старушки?
The Missing Piece#289.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#290.src: We are here to execute a search. You water usage levels have exceeded you authorized allotment.
The Missing Piece#290.dst: Мы здесь для обыска. Твой расход воды превысил разрешённую норму.
The Missing Piece#290.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#295.src: We'll be done here after we've finished our inspection.
The Missing Piece#295.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#296.src: Say, would you prefer us searching the lower or upper floor first?
The Missing Piece#296.dst: Скажи-ка, откуда начать обыск: снизу или сверху?
The Missing Piece#296.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#297.src: How kind of you to ask... but as there is nothing of interest anywhere, I would suggest you start by finding a reason to get out of my home.
The Missing Piece#297.dst: Как любезно спросить… но раз нигде нет ничего интересного, начните с поиска причины покинуть мой дом.
The Missing Piece#297.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#298.src: I wouldn't want to waste your time, is all.
The Missing Piece#298.dst: Не хочу отнимать у вас время, только и всего.
The Missing Piece#298.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#299.src: The lower floor then. Thank you for your cooperation.
The Missing Piece#299.dst: Тогда нижний этаж. Благодарю за содействие.
The Missing Piece#299.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#302.src: What's this? No wonder you're exceeding your water limit when you've been keeping illicit plants!
The Missing Piece#302.dst: Что это? Неудивительно, что расход воды превышен, когда тут незаконные растения!
The Missing Piece#302.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#303.src: Oh what's the matter with you!?
The Missing Piece#303.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#304.src: I've worked my whole life in the factories! Can't I have some flowers to keep me company in my old age?
The Missing Piece#304.dst: Я всю жизнь проработала на заводах! Неужто на старости лет нельзя пару цветов для компании?
The Missing Piece#304.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#305.src: Inspector. A message from the Authority.
The Missing Piece#305.speaker: Sentinel

The Missing Piece#309.dst: Вот. Итак, какое дело властям Её Величества до меня, старушки?
The Missing Piece#309.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#310.dst: Мы здесь для обыска. Твой расход воды превысил разрешённую норму.

The Missing Piece#315.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#316.dst: Скажи-ка, откуда начать обыск: снизу или сверху?
The Missing Piece#316.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#317.src: How kind of you to ask... but as the upper floor is my bedroom, I would prefer it if you didn't inspect my bedsheets.
The Missing Piece#317.dst: Как любезно спросить… но наверху моя спальня, и я бы предпочла, чтобы вы не осматривали мои простыни.
The Missing Piece#317.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#318.src: The upper floor then. Thank you for your cooperation.
The Missing Piece#318.dst: Тогда верхний этаж. Благодарю за содействие.
The Missing Piece#318.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#321.src: What's this? No wonder you're exceeding your water limit when you've been keeping illicit plants!
The Missing Piece#321.dst: Что это? Неудивительно, что расход воды превышен, когда тут незаконные растения!
The Missing Piece#321.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#322.src: Oh what's the matter with you!?
The Missing Piece#322.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#323.src: I've worked my whole life in the factories! Can't I have some flowers to keep me company in my old age?
The Missing Piece#323.dst: Я всю жизнь проработала на заводах! Неужто на старости лет нельзя пару цветов для компании?
The Missing Piece#323.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#324.src: How quaint. Doesn't it get lonely, living up here all by your lonesome?
The Missing Piece#324.dst: Как мило. Не одиноко тут жить совсем одной?
The Missing Piece#324.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#326.src: Anyhow, I am required to inform you that you are in breach of the ordinance on water usage and will have to-
The Missing Piece#326.dst: Так или иначе, обязан сообщить: ты нарушила постановление о расходе воды и должна будешь-
The Missing Piece#326.speaker: Inspector

The Missing Piece#327.src: Inspector. A message from the Authority.
The Missing Piece#327.speaker: Sentinel

The Missing Piece#331.src: There you go. Now, what business could Her Majesty's authorities possibly have with little old me?
The Missing Piece#331.dst: Вот. Итак, какое дело властям Её Величества до меня, старушки?
The Missing Piece#331.speaker: Elise
